snippet.title: Cup and Counter Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Cup and Counter is a cozy cafe management game where you build and grow your own cafe from the ground up.

Wishlist Cup and Counter: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4453300/Cup_and_Counter_Coffee_Shop_Simulator/?utm_source=youtube

Craft a wide range of delicious drinks, serve a steady stream of customers, and shape your shop into a space that feels truly yours. As your cafe grows, you will unlock new recipes, manage stock and deliveries, expand your floor space, and balance the day-to-day challenges of running a successful business.

From keeping up with busy rushes to planning your next upgrade, every decision helps shape the future of your cafe.

In Cup and Counter, you will:

Craft a wide range of drinks
Serve customers and build your reputation
Manage stock and plan deliveries
Expand and customize your cafe
Balance costs, pricing, and growth

Wishlist Cup and Counter on Steam and follow along for future updates.

#cozygames #indiegame #simulationgame #managementgame #coffeeshop #gamedev
